overall.headline: Target Rest of Asia & Pacific and Europe LCCs First; Avoid Unmapped and Sub-Saharan Segments
observations: Across **518** total recorded airlines with **165** electronic flight folder (EFF) records, **NavChina** leads with **38** recorded selections, followed by **AvioBook** at **21** and **In-house built** at **21**.
For flight planning, across **71** recorded airlines, **Lido** leads with **24** selections, **NavBlue** has **16**, and **FlightKeys** has **15**.
The Rest of Asia & Pacific and Europe & Central Asia regions hold the highest sample density and should be validated first for **Cathay Flight Folder**.
overall.caveat: This Airtable list represents a prospect sample, not the whole market. Blanks mean unknown, not non-adoption.
